registry.name: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN), Papua Tengah land office service area
registry.scope: The official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS service is the national public spatial-information portal and identifies land-office locations and land-parcel datasets. This establishes the national cadastral custodian and public viewer, not complete parcel coverage for the Nabire WUP city point.

queries.query: Nabire Indonesia official cadastral parcel map API ATR BPN Geoportal
queries.result: First-party results identified the official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive map, ATLAS geospatial portal, and ATR/BPN legal material on cadastral base maps. ATLAS publicly describes land-parcel layers and fields such as area, village, NIB, object name, rights status, and land use, but no anonymous Nabire parcel feature response was exposed by the inspected public pages.

queries.query: Nabire peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN cadastral
queries.result: The first-party search path led to ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS and official Indonesian cadastral-map guidance. The public catalog/landing pages describe the service and parcel-layer concepts, but did not return a bounded anonymous Nabire parcel geometry or a stable safe parcel identity. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe owner/title query was attempted.

registryEvidence.custodianQualification: National ATR/BPN public map and geospatial portal; no separate Nabire municipal cadastral custodian or local parcel API was evidenced.
registryEvidence.observedOfficialClaims: BHUMI is an interactive spatial-information map integrated with ATLAS; ATLAS documents datasets including land parcels and attributes such as area, village, NIB, object name, rights status, and land use. The documentation also cautions that official reliance requires an ATR/BPN public-information request.

service.name: ATR/BPN BHUMI / ATLAS public geospatial portal

nativeRoutesInspected: GET current JavaScript chunks referenced by the BHUMI landing page

The current landing-page JavaScript and public documentation were inspected; no bounded anonymous parcel query route with a Nabire response was established. No parcel geometry or safe native parcel ID was returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.

exactPointCheck.method: The exact WUP point [-3.36473972189266, 135.506804859334] was preserved in latitude/longitude order. No coordinate shift or synthetic parcel lookup was used.
exactPointCheck.result: No bounded anonymous feature response was available from the inspected public BHUMI/ATLAS routes. This is a public-service/API exposure limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

uncertainty: National ATR/BPN portal evidence establishes a relevant cadastral custodian and public viewer, but does not prove parcel coverage or completeness inside the WUP city boundary.

The public pages may require interactive map state, a later client-side route, or an information request for authoritative use; no credentials, private tokens, login wall bypass, or CAPTCHA/Cloudflare circumvention was attempted.
